definitions.explanation: A person one works with, emphasizing the sense of companionship and shared effort rather than formal organizational hierarchy.

examples.japanese: {仕事仲間|しごとなかま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had lunch with my work colleagues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仕事仲間|しごとなかま}⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧だ。
examples.english: He's not just a work colleague — he's a close friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仕事仲間|しごとなかま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: I often go out drinking with my coworkers on weekends.

notes:
Carries a warmer, more personal tone than ⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧ (colleague). ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧ implies camaraderie and a sense of being on the same team, so {仕事仲間|しごとなかま} suggests people you get along with at work, not merely people who happen to work at the same place.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事仲間|しごとなかま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go drinking with coworkers
- {仕事仲間|しごとなかま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧: to be blessed with good colleagues
- ⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な{仕事仲間|しごとなかま}: valued coworkers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧: colleague — more formal and neutral; no implication of personal closeness
- ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: people at one's workplace — general, no warmth implied
- ⟦{同期|どうき}→同期：12029_douki⟧: someone who joined the company in the same year — specific to hiring cohort
